aime_geometry_vera_e_generation.description: VeRA-E executable specification on the AIME-2024-II-10 geometry seed: seed-consistent verifier and deterministic generation of equivalent variants.

verified_variant_count.description: Diagnostic count of slice variants whose labels match the executable verifier; unweighted because raw output volume is gameable.

seed_consistency_rate.description: Fraction of seed checks whose executable verifier reproduces the known seed answer.

valid_rate.description: Fraction of generated slice variants with verifier-consistent numeric answers.

valid_assignment_diversity_rate.description: Fraction of slice rows that are distinct valid slot assignments, penalizing duplicated or memorized variants.

valid_seed_answer_novelty_rate.description: Fraction of slice rows that are valid and have an answer different from the corresponding seed answer, penalizing seed replay.

deterministic_replay_rate.description: Fraction of slice rows that regenerate the same assignment and answer under deterministic replay.

aime_additional_vera_e_generation.description: Additional paper-shown VeRA-E executable specifications: chip-grid maximal placements and polygon rotation probability.

verified_variant_count.description: Diagnostic count of slice variants whose labels match the executable verifier across the additional specifications; unweighted because raw output volume is gameable.

seed_consistency_rate.description: Fraction of additional seed checks whose executable verifiers reproduce the known seed answers.

valid_rate.description: Fraction of generated slice variants with verifier-consistent numeric answers across the additional specifications.

valid_assignment_diversity_rate.description: Fraction of slice rows that are distinct valid slot assignments across the additional specifications.

valid_seed_answer_novelty_rate.description: Fraction of additional slice rows that are valid and have answers different from their corresponding seed answers.

valid_spec_coverage_rate.description: Fraction of expected additional specifications represented by at least one valid slice variant.

deterministic_replay_rate.description: Fraction of additional slice rows that regenerate the same assignment and answer under deterministic replay.

aime_geometry_vera_h_hardening.description: VeRA-H and VeRA-H Pro on the same geometry seed: verified hardened candidates and hardest-candidate selection.

verified_variant_count.description: Diagnostic count of hardened slice variants whose labels match the executable verifier; unweighted because raw output volume is gameable.

noise_judge_pass_rate.description: Fraction of hardened slice variants whose correct answer is accepted and nearby wrong answers are rejected by the offline checker.

valid_assignment_diversity_rate.description: Fraction of hardened slice rows that are distinct valid slot assignments.

valid_seed_answer_novelty_rate.description: Fraction of hardened slice rows that are valid and have answers different from the original hardened seed answer.

valid_hardness_diversity_rate.description: Fraction of hardened slice rows covering distinct valid difficulty ranks.

h_pro_selected_ranked.description: Whether the selected VeRA-H Pro artifact is valid and matches the hardest generated rank.
